meta.title: 脸部上镜三要素——上篇：眼神管理
meta.title_en: Three Keys to Photogenic Faces — Part 1: Eye Direction

scenes.title_cn: 侧面拍摄：当拍侧面的时候，全是眼白。…
scenes.title_en: Side profile: when you shoot from the side…
sentences: 当你拍侧面的时候，全是眼白。
When you shoot a profile, it's all sclera.
all sclera（全是眼白）
头不动，让眼珠子去找向手机的方向。
Keep the head still and let the eyeballs find the phone.
eyeballs find the phone（眼珠找手机）
scenes.speak: When you shoot a profile, it's all sclera. Keep the head still and let the eyeballs find the phone.

scenes.title_cn: 抬头拍摄：当你抬头的时候，是不是像翻…
scenes.title_en: Looking up: when you lift your chin, it lo…
scenes.context: 抬头时眼珠下压防翻白眼。
sentences: 当你抬头的时候，是不是像翻白眼。
When you lift your chin, it looks like eye-rolling.
eye-rolling（翻白眼）
抬头头照样抬着，眼珠子可以稍微略低一点。
Keep the chin up, but set the eyeballs slightly lower.
eyeballs lower（眼珠略低）
从你脑门方向去延伸。
Extend from the direction of your forehead.
extend from forehead（从脑门延伸）
scenes.speak: When you lift your chin, it looks like eye-rolling. Keep the chin up, but set the eyeballs slightly lower. Extend from the direction of your forehead.

scenes.title_cn: 低头拍摄：当你低头的时候，是不是像闭…
scenes.title_en: Looking down: when you dip your head, it l…
scenes.context: 低头时眼珠向地板延伸。
sentences: 当你低头的时候，是不是像闭眼。
When you dip your head, it looks like your eyes are shut.
looks shut（像闭眼）
头还是照样的低，眼珠子去找向地板延伸的方向。
Keep the head low, eyeballs looking toward the floor.
look toward the floor（向地板延伸）
scenes.speak: When you dip your head, it looks like your eyes are shut. Keep the head low, eyeballs looking toward the floor.

scenes.title_cn: 正面拍摄：当你拍正面的时候，像拍证件…
scenes.title_en: Front view: straight-on shots look like ID…
scenes.context: 正面时眼珠偏离镜头中心。
sentences: 当你拍正面的时候，像拍证件照。
Straight-on shots look like ID photos.
ID-photo look（证件照感）
依旧头不动，眼珠子可以看向镜头的左边，也可以看向右边。
Keep the head still; look left or right of the lens.
look off-center（偏离中心）
别再说你们不会眼神管理了。
Don't say you can't manage your gaze anymore.
manage your gaze（眼神管理）
scenes.speak: Straight-on shots look like ID photos. Keep the head still; look left or right of the lens. Don't say you can't manage your gaze anymore.

practice: Keep the head still; let the eyes find the phone.
Chin up but eyeballs sit slightly lower.
Eyes look toward the floor direction.
Look left or right of the lens.
pitfalls: Show all sclera in profile shots.
Keep the head still and roll your eyes toward the phone.
侧脸时眼珠要转向手机。
Roll your eyes when tilting up.
Keep the chin up but the eyeballs lower.
抬头时眼珠略低，避免翻白眼。
Shut your eyes when looking down.
Keep the head low and look toward the floor.
低头时眼珠向地板延伸。
Look slightly left or right of the lens.
正面时眼珠偏离镜头中心更灵动。
shifts: 用 eyeballs（眼珠）、sclera（眼白）、roll your eyes（翻白眼）
用 chin up（抬头）、head low（低头）、keep the head still（头不动）
用 look toward the floor（向地板）、extend from forehead（从脑门延伸）、off-center（偏离中心）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：侧面全是眼白、头不动、眼珠找手机、抬头翻白眼、眼珠略低、脑门方向延伸、低头像闭眼、眼珠向地板延伸、正面像证件照、眼珠看镜头左边右边、眼神管理等。
